decision.uploadRoute: Proposed bounded raw CreateArtifact -> PutBlock(C) -> PutBlockList(Uncommitted) -> FinalizeArtifact
decision.runtimeBaseline: Proposed repository-owned pinned Node24 JavaScript action with built-in HTTPS/crypto only; PowerShell remains nonsecret producer/validator. No runtime installed/executed; runner/Node revisions unbound.
decision.protocolSupport: Internal/unsupported GitHub artifact protocol inferred from pinned published client; not a public raw-upload guarantee.
decision.identityRequired: FrozenC == streamedbody == ordinaryRESTdownloadR byte-for-byte; exactmetadataN/H and canonical/content gates required.
decision.credentialBoundary: Runtime/read credentials remain in action process; separate credential-scoped uploader and observer interfaces; no shell/env-file/output/argv credential transfer.

canaryProposalNotAuthorization.workflowCandidateRef: Separate reviewed canary-only branch, not created by this design.

sourceInspection.limits: Distribution integrity ties reference bytes to pinned lock; it is not service availability, build reproducibility or approved future client source/dependency provenance. No tag/commit is invented.

requiredBeforeLive: Independent design disposition, then separate implementation and deny-by-default synthetic/crash/identity/credential/budget gates.
Exact reviewed producer/transport/observer/canary source and API/dependency pins.
Reviewed runner-to-JavaScript-action runtime credential injection contract, exact runner/Node pins, and missing-context refusal; no credential bootstrap fallback.
Actual repository/workflow IDs, source/ref, host/version bindings and workflow registration/ref-selection checks.
Exclusive protected canary ref or enforceable write-exclusion window through source selection/execution; post-run head_sha comparison alone is insufficient.
Exact source/package evidence and operational refusal/quarantine regression proof.
Separately reviewed bounded control-plane procedure and exclusive/concurrency-safe Actions restoration window.
Explicit new authorization for any hosted compute, GitHub runtime credential use and synthetic artifact writes.
No tenant/private evidence, signing, production sealer activation, publication, PR or merge.

review.disposition: No remaining material design finding. Runtime credential boundary, implicit wire replay, restart budgets, source-ref exclusion and credential wording addressed. Implementation, runner-injection proof and live interoperability remain pending; no activation authorization.

checks: JSON blocked flags, budget arithmetic and prerequisite invariants
